sources.title: GitHub - vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight: Agent Memory That Learns
sources.snippet: Memory Performance & Accuracy Hindsight is the most accurate agent memory system ever tested according to benchmark performance. It has achieved state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark, widely used to assess memory system performance across a variety of conversational AI scenarios.
